structured.answer: On this page the lowest fee for a share-index track in קופת גמל להשקעה looks like אלטשולר שחם, 0.56% of the savings and 0% of deposits, with מנורה מבטחים close behind at 0.57%. But I only found 9 of the 11 companies the page mentions, so I'd check with my son before doing anything.

stuck.where: Between screen 2 and screen 3 / the line '11 מסלולים של 11 חברות'
stuck.why: The page promises 11 companies but I counted only 9 rows (מור, אנליסט, מיטב, אלטשולר שחם, הפניקס, מגדל, מנורה, אינפיניטי, איילון); not sure if I missed some while scrolling
Companies are sorted by size of money, not by fee, so I had to compare every fee myself; I expected the cheapest at the top
'מהחיסכון' and 'מההפקדות' – not sure if they are added together or which one matters

Company header lines 'דמי ניהול מהחיסכון: מ־0.56% עד 0.56%'
